interpretation_limits: Only public h3 FP32 outputs promoted to FP64 are analyzed; no h3 internal FP64 W trajectory or physical G_W is inferred.
Newton residuals are the values printed by the solver and are not physical G_W.
The 24-row h3 reference screen is the only reference qualification criterion; D1/D2 ratio and cosine are not additional gates.
A failed h3 screen does not trigger a smaller timestep.

three_level_shape_diagnostics.interpretation: D1/D2 RMS ratio and cosine are descriptive; no Richardson fit, convergence-order claim, pass condition, or correction.
